alignment: All complete chains global PairwiseAligner. Match=2 mismatch=-1 gap_open=-6 gap_extend=-0.5. Protein terminal gaps unpenalized, peptide terminal gaps penalized. Gaps retained explicitly and every state residue occurs exactly once per role.
CDR: a-state complete CDR boundaries projected globally to b; MEL5 family uses original 3HG1 WT boundaries. Unrelated TCR loop maps marked exploratory, not homologous mechanism proof.

filters.no_chi: hchi_valid false is missing/undefined, not zero entropy

replicates: ITrace=3 independent existing MD replicas per state; CatchBond=10. SEM=sqrt(var_a/n_a+var_b/n_b), no frame/residue pseudoreplication. No significance tests.
MD_role: Corroboration only; not physical truth or a measurement of affinity.
source_fields: <pdb>_source_audit.json has exact source NPZ/structure path and SHA256, actual chain-role mapping; every <a>_<b>_alignment_audit.json includes sequences and full alignments.
